lines.speaker: Anna
lines.translation: When are you coming to the park?

lines.speaker: Béla
lines.text: Három órakor megyek. Hol találkozunk pontosan?
lines.translation: I go at three o’clock. Where do we meet exactly?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.translation: I will wait for you next to the shop.

lines.speaker: Béla
lines.translation: Okay. Which way should I go?
